description_en: Ālko Gaṇeśa Mandira was built in 1704 CE and is located in the Ālko Hiti complex (LAL0990) at Ikhāchẽ, Patan. The temple faces west and has one roof covered with traditional tiles (jhĩgaṭī). The roof is surmounted by a metal pinnacle. A stone statue of Nandī is installed in front of the temple and a stone statue of Gaṇeśa is consecrated in its sanctum. Gaṇeśa is worshipped as the local deity (sthānadeva) by the residents of Ikhāchẽ. Ganesa is worshipped before auspicious rituals such as rice feeding, initiation are conducted.The temple was built by Yaśovanta Siṃha Raghuvaṃśa in 1704 CE (NS 824). A group of six people donated twenty silver coins namedmahendra mallīin 1755 CE (NS 875). An individual named Bhavānī Rāotta (Rāuta) Raghuvaṃśa and his wife offered a golden pinnacle to the temple in 1864 CE (NS 984).The temple was renovated in 2017 CE (VS 2074) with the financial support of thirty lakhs rupees from the Lalitpur Metropolitan City. Some of the old struts were restored during the renovation. It has not been formally inaugurated yet (April 2021), although the renovation is already completed.The temple has no priest to carry out the daily and other rituals. A Taṇḍukāra family is responsible for the maintenance of the temple as its caretakers (dyaḥpāḥlāḥ).
description_ne: आल्को हिति (LAL0990) को कम्पाउण्डभित्र रहेकोले यस मन्दिरलाई आल्को गणेश मन्दिर भनिएको हो । यो मन्दिर इखाछेँ टोलको थान गणेश हो । त्यसैले इखाछेँ टोलमा कसैको पास्नी, व्रतबन्ध, भीमरथारोहण जस्ता संस्कार गर्दा सबैभन्दा पहिले यहीँ आएर पूजा गर्नुपर्ने परम्परा रहिआएको छ ।एक तहको छाना रहेको यो मन्दिर दक्षिणाभिमुख गरी बनाइएको छ । धातुको गजूर राखिएको यस मन्दिरको छानामा झिंगटी राखिएको छ । मन्दिरको गर्भगृहमा दक्षिणाभिमुख गरी ढुंगाको गणेश स्थापना गरिएको छ । मन्दिर अगाडि ढुंगाको बसाहा स्थापना गरिएको छ ।यो मन्दिर नेसं ८२४ (सन् १७०४) मा रघुवंश यशोवन्तसिंहले स्थापना गरेका थिए । नेसं ८७५ (सन् १७५५) मा ६ जनाको समूहले गणेशको पूजा गर्न चाँदीको २० महेन्द्र मल्ली मुद्रा चढाइएका थिए । नेसं ९८४ (सन् १८६४) मा रघुवंश राओत्त भवानि भारोले श्रीमती सुवर्णलक्ष्मीसँग मिलेर गणेश मन्दिरमा सुनको गजूर चढाएका थिए ।विसं २०७४ (सन् २०१७) मा यो मन्दिरको पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो । मन्दिरको पुनर्निर्माण गर्नको लागि ललितपुर महानगरपालिकाबाट दुई किस्तामा गरी रु. ३० लाखको आर्थिक सहयोग प्राप्त भएको थियो । पुनर्निर्माण गर्दा केही टुँडालहरू पुरानै राखिएका छन् । पुनर्निर्माणको कार्य समाप्त भएपनि अहिलेसम्म पनि समुद्घाटन गरिएको छैन ।मन्दिरमा कुनै पुजारी नियुक्त गरिएको छैन । तण्डुकार थरको एउटा परिवारले द्य:पा:ला:को काम गर्दै आइरहेको छ । मन्दिरमा प्रत्येक हप्ता मंगलवार बेलुकी भजन गरिन्छ । प्रत्येक वर्ष भाद्र शुक्ल १३ (इन्द्रजात्रा) को दिनमा मन्दिरको अगाडि समयबजि प्रदर्शन गरिन्छ ।

historical_events.event_description: A balustrade, supporting small oil recepticals, was installed around the temple. The supporting structure is made of steel angles and rectangular tubing.

historical_events.event_name: Gaṇeśa Statue Turning into White Color and the Death of the Son of King Rājya Prakāśa Malla
historical_events.event_description: According toKāyastha(NS 1117, 19), the Gaṇeśa statue consecrated in the sanctum of this temple turned into white. Such an incident is considered inauspicious among Newars. Soon after this incident, the son of King Rājya Prakāśa Malla (1745-1758 CE) died.
The temple was renovated in 2017 CE (VS 2074) with the financial support of thirty lakhs rupees from the Lalitpur Metropolitan City.

historical_events.event_name: Unknown Event (not related to the temple)
historical_events.event_description: This inscription was issued before the construction of the Ālko Gaṇeśa Temple. Since it is severely damaged, its content remains obscure.

historical_events.event_name: Initial Construction of the Temple and Establishment of a Guṭhī
historical_events.event_description: The temple was built by Yaśovanta Siṃha Raghuvaṃśa in 1704 CE (NS 824). On its completion, he had offered a feast to Brahmins and Jośīs, and also established aguṭhīfor its regular operation.

This inscription, kept inside the Ālko Gaṇeśa Temple, is not related to the temple itself. It records the initial construction of aphalcāby Bhavanīśaṅkara. Thephalcārecorded in the inscription is not yet identified.
A group of eight people offered twenty silver coins namedmahendra mallīto the temple to sponsor regular worship of Gaṇeśa and light up oil lamps on every first day of the bright fortnight of Bhādra.
Bhavānī Rāotta (Rāuta) Raghuvaṃśa and his wife offered a gold pinnacle to the temple in 1864 CE (NS 984).
Devarāja Śākya, a resident of the Ikhāchẽ Ṭola, offered this banner wishing for the salvation of his deceased parents (his father and mother died on 26-05-VS 2054 and 12-08-VS 2075, respectively).
